name: external-undeclared-mapping
description: API review is unavailable and CLI clients are present, but the operator has declared no client-to-provider mapping; the actor must ask one focused question rather than guessing or silently reviewing internally only.
prompt: Use `$kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: With no declared mapping the actor either infers providers from executable names and dispatches, or silently drops every client and reports an internal-only review without asking.

assertions.text: The actor loads the isolated workflow and the shared external-review protocol before stating a backend decision.
The backend decision is clink and no external request is sent before the mapping is resolved; no provider is inferred from the names claude, agy or codex.

The actor asks exactly one focused question that lists every discovered client lacking a declared provider (claude, agy, codex) and asks which provider each belongs to, noting the answer can be recorded in the project's agent instruction file; the authoring provider (OpenAI) is stated so the user can see which answer leads to exclusion.

The internal reviewer proceeds and its P1 is reported with attribution; the report states the pending roster question as the reason for zero external coverage rather than reporting an internal-only review as the settled outcome.
